story.title: Apple's iOS 27 to let users choose their own AI model for Siri tasks, opening system to third parties
story.summary: Apple is reportedly planning to redesign iOS 27 so that users can select from a range of third-party AI models to power tasks across the operating system, moving away from a single default model approach. The change would allow consumers to pick models from competing providers for functions like writing assistance, summarisation, and smart replies. This would represent a fundamental shift in how Apple controls the AI layer of its devices and could reshape competition among AI model providers.
